root_cause.text: The connector pointer was not initialized early enough in the atomic_enable() function, causing a NULL pointer dereference when error recovery paths like cdns_mhdp_modeset_retry_fn() attempted to access the connector's mutex before the connector was set.
root_cause.evidence: The patch moves the connector pointer assignment (`mhdp->connector_ptr = drm_atomic_get_new_connector_for_encoder(...)`) to the beginning of cdns_mhdp_atomic_enable(), immediately after acquiring the link_mutex and before any operations that could fail (cdns_mhdp_link_up(), cdns_mhdp_reg_read()). The CVE description explicitly states: "In case if we get errors in cdns_mhdp_link_up() or cdns_mhdp_reg_read() in atomic_enable, we will go to cdns_mhdp_modeset_retry_fn() and will hit NULL pointer while trying to access the mutex." The patch also changes cdns_mhdp_modeset_retry_fn() to use `mhdp->connector_ptr` instead of `&mhdp->connector`, and adds a NULL check in cdns_mhdp_hdcp_check_link() to guard against accessing a NULL connector_ptr.

bic_trace_step.reason: The vulnerability root cause describes a NULL pointer dereference when error recovery paths like cdns_mhdp_modeset_retry_fn() attempt to access the connector's mutex before the connector is initialized. In the cdns_mhdp_atomic_enable() function (starting around line 2100), the connector is retrieved via drm_atomic_get_new_connector_for_encoder() but this happens AFTER the mutex_lock(&mhdp->link_mutex) at line 2095. If an error occurs before the connector is properly set (lines 2110-2112 show WARN_ON checks), the function jumps to 'out:' label at line 2155 and calls schedule_work(&mhdp->modeset_retry_work). The cdns_mhdp_modeset_retry_fn() work function (line 1945) then accesses mhdp->connector directly without checking if it was properly initialized. Additionally, in cdns_mhdp_connector_init() (line 1780), the connector is initialized, but this is called from cdns_mhdp_attach() which may be called after atomic_enable(). The connector pointer in mhdp->connector is not guaranteed to be initialized early enough before error paths in atomic_enable() attempt to use it via the work queue function.
